_comment: Install at ~/.codex/hooks.json (user) or .codex/hooks.json (project). Replace __HOOK_DIR__ with the absolute path to examples/coding-agent-guard/hooks. `install.sh codex` does this for you. Codex reads a top-level "hooks" object, not a top-level PreToolUse key. Codex does not call a hook it has not been made to trust: start codex and accept the hook when it asks. The wrapper returns an escalation as a denial. docs/support-matrix.md lists what was measured and on which version.
